opening.quote: Good afternoon, Home, my name is Sanne. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name but said only 'Home' instead of the full company name Tidewell Home, so the company name was not clearly given.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and your order number or postcode, please?
verification.comment: You asked for full name and order number before discussing the order, and the caller provided both, so this was done correctly.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when a €84.00 will me back on your card?
understanding.comment: You captured the refund question correctly and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: sew it will be on your card within 9 working days from yesterdays.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving, and the bank typically shows it within 3 to 5 further working days; stating 9 working days was an incorrect timeline, so give the correct policy timeline.

process_compliance.quote: Can I put you on hold for a moment while I check the refund is queued?
process_compliance.comment: You asked permission before placing the caller on hold and thanked her on return, which meets the hold requirement.

communication.quote: Thank you for waiting. It's queued, and you'll get an email it the day it's paid.
communication.comment: You were polite throughout and the caller was not frustrated, so the tone was appropriate.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the refund was queued, asked if anything else was needed, and closed politely, which meets the closing standard.
